text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Learning in Action Part A, students fill a quote-and-inference chart while the teacher reads pp. 1–8, and Part C asks them to support a prediction with a quoted detail."},{"code":"RL.6.2","verdict":"partly","reason":"Part C has students name an emerging theme and cite a detail, but students never write a summary of the text distinct from opinion, and the theme is only tentative."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"The Word Building routine has students work out mortal, immortal, mythology, and transport from word parts and verify them, and Part A has students use the sentence around expelled and probation to check their guesses."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Part A read-aloud and Part B tone work cover The Lightning Thief pp. 1–8 as the Outline names, and the homework extends to pp. 9–15."}}
